text:
taylor (sales): quick heads-up: Prospect (MegaBank) asked for explicit IAM proofs in the SIG. They want evidence for: scoped admin roles, emergency break-glass process, SCIM provisioning logs, MFA enforcement timeline, session timeout & reauth, and a sample tenant-scoped policy for Dedicated. Can we assemble a minimal set for their vendor team?

nina (eng-security): Yep. We have a curated pack we can tailor. Items I'll include: 1) SCIM provisioning audit (CSV) with timestamps and provision source. 2) MFA enforcement policy history (when policy was created/changed). 3) Emergency break-glass runbook + last three uses (redacted). 4) Session timeout config (console and API) + evidence of enforcement. 5) Tenant-scoped policy sample + diagram.

ryan (solutions): For SIG they usually accept redacted logs + screenshots. If they require a live walkthrough we can schedule a 30-min call and show a simulated break-glass escalation (scoped demo org).

taylor (sales): Great. They specifically asked: "how do you prevent cross-customer visibility in Dedicated?" Need a one-paragraph answer for their risk reviewer.

leah (sales-eng): Short answer: control plane enforces project-scoped bindings at the RBAC layer and all API calls are filtered by tenant ID at the gateway. We'll provide a sample policy and an example TLS-authenticated service-account token that only lists resources in project:megabank-prod.

nina (eng-security): SCIM example (we'll attach CSV export): header: event_ts, user_email, action, source_system, mapped_groups. Sample row: `2025-01-08T14:22:11Z,alice@megabank.com,created,okta,okta:MGMT-ADMINS`

nina (eng-security): Emergency break-glass: our flow uses `breakglass` group gating + time-limited elevated token issuance. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/Sec/BreakGlass. We'll attach a redacted transcript of the last invocation (ticket id redacted).

ryan (solutions): MFA timeline: policy created 2023-11-02, enforced for `org-admins` and `support-admins` since 2023-11-09. Enforcement evidence: Okta policy export + screenshot.

leah (sales-eng): Session & reauth: console sessions default 8h max, idle timeout 30m; API tokens (service accounts) TTL 24h and retrieved via Vault. We'll include a config snippet: `session.max_duration=28800s` and `session.idle_timeout=1800s`.

nina (eng-security): Tenant-scoped policy (yaml snippet):
```yaml
bindings:
  - role: project-reader
    subject: group:megabank-readers
    scope: project:megabank-prod
  - role: project-admin
    subject: group:megabank-admins
    scope: project:megabank-prod
```
This is enforced by the control plane and validated at the API gateway layer.

taylor (sales): They also asked about separation of duties / ability to revoke admin access quickly. What's practical evidence?

nina (eng-security): We can provide: 1) sample Jira approval ticket showing a timed elevation request and approval flow (redacted). 2) Audit log snippet showing the revoke event. 3) Policy that admin elevation requires two approvers for > 2h access.

infra-bot: artifact-upload: signed-iam-pack.zip uploaded to https://internal.artifacts/redwood/sales/1954332100-signed-iam-pack.zip :white_check_mark:

ryan (solutions): Also include SCIM delta script we use for provisioning (command example):
```
python infra/tools/scim_delta.py --from 2025-01-01 --to 2025-01-10 --format csv > scim_provision_0101_0110.csv
```

nina (eng-security): For logs redaction use `tools/redact_logs.py --mask-emails --mask-userids`. We'll attach sanitized exports. Do NOT share unredacted logs externally.

leah (sales-eng): I'll assemble a one-page cover letter: short answers + where each artifact lives, plus a note about Dedicated tenant isolation.

ryan (solutions): If they require CAIQ-level detail, we'll need extra time for architecture diagrams and policy extracts. Tell them ~5 business days.

taylor (sales): Please aim to get the package by COB Pacific. I want to keep the deal moving. Ping me if anything blocks.

nina (eng-security): Will do. I'll attach: scim CSV, okta_policy.png, breakglass_runbook.pdf (redacted), session_config.txt, tenant_policy.yaml, sanitized_audit_90d.json.

leah (sales-eng): Uploaded final: 1954332100-sig-iam-evidence.zip -> /sfdc/attachments/1954332100. Sending to vendor now.

taylor (sales): Thanks team :tada:
